title: Migration & Modernization: The 6 Rs & Wave Planning — D5
purpose: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
routing_rationale: Selecting the proper migration path balances migration velocity, operational refactoring cost, and long-term cloud native agility.

nodes.label: VMware ESXi Workloads
nodes.detail: Monolithic enterprise applications running on legacy VMware vSphere infrastructure.

nodes.label: On-Prem Oracle / MySQL DB
nodes.detail: Core transaction database holding critical customer transaction history.

nodes.label: Migrate to Virtual Machines
nodes.detail: Streams OS disk blocks directly into Google Cloud Persistent Disk with zero downtime.

nodes.label: Database Migration Service
nodes.detail: Serverless streaming replication with schema translation to Cloud SQL / AlloyDB.

nodes.label: Compute Engine / GKE
nodes.detail: Rehosted VMs running on Compute Engine or refactored into GKE containers.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL / AlloyDB
nodes.detail: Target managed database running with automatic maintenance, HA, and automated backups.

steps.title: Continuous Background Replication
steps.action: M4VM and DMS stream data over Dedicated Interconnect while on-prem services remain live.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates multi-day maintenance outages during enterprise data synchronization.

steps.title: Final Cutover & Launch
steps.action: Final delta sync completes in < 3 minutes; traffic switches over to GCP with minimal downtime.
steps.why_traversal: Provides clean, controlled cutover with verified data consistency.

scenarios.label: Interconnect Bandwidth Saturation
scenarios.root_cause: Under-sized Cloud Interconnect saturated by unthrottled block replication.
scenarios.diverted_path: Production on-prem traffic experiences high packet loss.
scenarios.recovery: Enable bandwidth rate limiting on M4VM replication schedules during business hours.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
